A '''pit droid air gun''' was a device that shot compressed air to drill holes and clear blockages. It required two [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]] to lift it.<ref name="TEVD" /> The air gun could be used as a weapon.<ref name="HtHTT">''[[Star Wars: Head-to-Head Tag Teams]]''</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the preparations for the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], an [[Otoga-222 maintenance droid/Legends|Otoga-222 maintenance droid]] used a pit droid air gun on [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano's]] custom [[Ord Pedrovia/Legends|Ord Pedrovia]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]].<ref name="TPM" />
